title: Juku: tool and pipeline health
description: Arthur only. No panel shows a nickname, question text or one learner's data (Phase 2 M4).

targets.rawSql: SELECT extract(epoch FROM now() - max(beat_at)) AS seconds FROM monitoring.heartbeats WHERE source = 'app'
SELECT DISTINCT ON (source) source, imported_at, lines_imported, lines_total, is_intact, array_length(problems, 1) AS problems FROM monitoring.audit_imports ORDER BY source, imported_at DESC

SELECT e.job, e.every, max(r.finished_at) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'succeeded') AS last_success, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'failed' AND r.started_at > now() - interval '7 days') AS failures_7d FROM monitoring.expected_jobs e LEFT JOIN monitoring.job_runs r USING (job) GROUP BY e.job, e.every ORDER BY e.job

panels.title: Tool calls per hour, by agent

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', called_at) AS time, agent AS metric, count(*) AS calls FROM monitoring.tool_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(called_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Errors, refusals and p95 latency, by tool

targets.rawSql: SELECT server, tool, count(*) AS calls, round(avg((outcome IN ('tool_error', 'transport_error'))::int) * 100, 1) AS error_pct, round(avg((outcome = 'refused')::int) * 100, 1) AS refused_pct, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) AS p95_ms FROM monitoring.tool_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(called_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Refusals by layer
panels.description: The gateway's policy and detector, and Juku's MCP server's token checks.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN source = 'gateway' AND is_suspicious THEN 'gateway: injection detector' WHEN source = 'gateway' THEN 'gateway: ' || decision ELSE 'juku-mcp: ' || coalesce(reason_category, 'other') END AS layer, count(*) AS refusals FROM monitoring.audit_lines WHERE $__timeFilter(logged_at) AND (is_suspicious OR decision IN ('refused', 'denied', 'blocked', 'rate_limited')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Calls through the gateway, by caller

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', logged_at) AS time, caller AS metric, count(*) AS calls FROM monitoring.audit_lines WHERE source = 'gateway' AND kind = 'call' AND $__timeFilter(logged_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
